svg.text: Try the update on an isolated copy first
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Isolated restored APP01 copy and a private test client
Use your tested restore to build a separate copy. Keep the original APP01 protected, outgoing
mail disabled on the copy and shared DNS unchanged. Use an isolated client’s temporary hosts
entry for helpdesk.lab.example.test to reach only this test copy.
On the copy, map this site’s PHP handler and corresponding FastCGI application to the staged
candidate, as described in the next step. Adjust PHPRC/PHP_INI_SCAN_DIR only for this app if
they point to an old configuration. A shared global variable requires a separate impact review;
do not change other apps silently.
Start the copy’s pool. Verify the web-served version, staff login, a fake ticket, a reply,
attachment upload/download and the PHP/IIS error logs. Keep real outgoing mail disabled; record
that mail still needs its live acceptance check.
If any test fails, stop here. Fix the candidate configuration or obtain a supported fix. Remove
the isolated client’s temporary hosts entry after the pilot.
Check: The isolated copy passes the recorded application checks on the patched candidate. No
